items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I recall Claude Williams telling me it was such a great band...

ctx.x: I recall Claude Williams telling me it was such a great band and you had such a hard time. You'd get a job and then something would happen and you'd be out of work for a while, then you'd get another job. It was hard to keep the band together the last couple of years.
